title: VeriCEMS Telemetry Packet
description: Signed, hash-chained edge telemetry packet produced by the CEMS gateway.

device_id.description: Unique identifier of the registered edge gateway device.

seq.description: Strictly increasing 0-indexed packet sequence number per device.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp in second precision with trailing Z (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

values.description: Map of channel name (from schemas/channels.json) to numeric sensor reading.

prev_hash.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase 32-byte hex SHA-256 packet_hash of the immediately preceding packet, or 32 zero bytes for seq=0.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase 64-byte hex raw (r || s) deterministic ECDSA P-256 signature over the 32-byte packet_hash.
